ValidationRule.description: This prevents users, except system admin, from adding/editing time cards for previous months if invoicing is approved
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Billing_Milestones__r.Timecards_Locked__c && OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( Date__c ), ISCHANGED( Hours__c ), ISCHANGED( Type__c ), ISCHANGED( Name ), ISCHANGED( Billing_Milestones__c ), ISCHANGED( Assignment__c ), ISCHANGED( Description_of_Work__c )) && NOT( $Profile.Id = "00e30000001esHI" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the System Admin can enter/update timecards for this date as the time for this month has been reviewed/invoiced.
